Unit-I-(Sec-II) .          30/12/2016                    (2)

Direct Computation of DFT :   x(n) -> complex valued.

              N-1
X_R(k) =      E    [x_R(n) cos(2 pi k n / N) + x_I(n) sin(2 pi k n / N)]
              n=0

              N-1
X_I(k) =  -   E    [x_R(n) sin(2 pi k n / N) - x_I(n) cos(2 pi k n / N)]
              n=0

Types of computation.
1. 2N^2 evaluation of trignometric functions for X_R(k).
   - N -> cos(.), N - sin(.)  -> 2N x N for k=0,..
                                          N-1.
   - use the same values in X_I(k).
2. 4N^2 real multiplications
   - (N+N) N . for X_R(k)   (N+N) N for X_I(k)
3. 4N (N-1) real additions .
   - ((N-1) adds. + (N-1) adds) x N  ->  X_R(k)
                                          k=0,..N-1.
     ((N-1) adds + (N-1) adds ) x N  -  X_I(k)
4. No. of indexing & addressing operations.
   Store - cos, sin fns. , store - x(n).
   store - X(k)'s.

description: Dense mathematical derivation: complexity analysis and twiddle-factor symmetry/periodicity proofs with exponentials and subscripts.
text:
Recall. - direct computation of X(k) requires.
N - complex multiplications       for each
N-1 complex additions .           X(k) .
: . for all k, N(N-1) additions.
             N^2 multiplications .
: . Complexity of DFT -> O(N^2) .
Goal :- Reduce this complexity :
To exploit:
(1) Symmetry property:  W_N^(k+N/2) = - W_N^k .
    W_N = e^(-j2 pi /N) .
    W_N^(k+N/2) = e^(-j2 pi (k+N/2)/N)
                = e^(-j pi) . e^(-j2 pi k/N) = - W_N^k .
(2) Periodicity property  W_N^(k+N) = W_N^k .
    W_N^(k+N) = e^(-j2 pi (k+N)/N)
              = e^(-j2 pi) . e^(-j2 pi k/N) = W_N^k .
